summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by AstraZeneca PLC, a foreign private issuer, notifying the admission of 14,120 ordinary shares (US$0.25 par, ISIN GB0009895292) to trading on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market under a block admission dated 29 January 2021. The shares were issued between 1 May and 31 May 2026 under the company's employee share schemes. No price, premium, or strategic event is disclosed. There is no special situation; it is a standard equity-line maintenance filing. No further action or risk-arb angle is warranted.
